newsitem.title: POLAND: Vereinsbank boosts capital of Polish unit. [CORRECTED 10:25 GMT 12/7]
newsitem.headline: Vereinsbank boosts capital of Polish unit. [CORRECTED 10:25 GMT 12/7]

text.p: Germany's Bayerische Vereinsbank AG has increased share capital of its fully-owned Polish subsidiary Vereinsbank Polska SA to 276 million zlotys from 185 million (corrects from 100 million), the bank said on Friday.
The bank said in a statement it planned to open offices the cities of Poznan, Wroclaw, Gdansk and Katowice or Krakow by the end of the year.
The bank started Polish operations in September 1996 and focuses primarily on large companies operating in Poland.
Bayerische won a full Polish banking license late in 1995 after it agreed to take over a failed small Megabank.
